rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a screenplay when the medium is clear from context.

example.traditional: 呢份劇本寫得好有張力。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 kek6 bun2 se2 dak1 hou2 jau5 zoeng1 lik6

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean a script written for a film rather than a general script.

example.english: After reading the screenplay, the director decided to start filming immediately.
example.traditional: 導演睇完電影劇本之後，決定即刻開拍。
example.jyutping: dou6 jin2 tai2 jyun4 din6 jing2 kek6 bun2 zi1 hau6 kyut3 ding6 zik1 hak1 hoi1 paak3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a script written for a television show.

example.english: The screenwriter is still revising the screenplay and has not finished it yet.
example.traditional: 編劇仲喺度修改電視劇本，未交到貨。
example.jyutping: pin1 kek6 zung6 hai2 dou6 sau1 goi2 din6 si6 kek6 bun2 mei6 gaau1 dou3 fo3
